Avocado night cream 1 kg

Our avocado night cream in 1 kg packing is the same rich cream as our 30 g retail jar: avocado with aloe vera, vitamin B3 (niacinamide) and kojic acid. It is the cream most bulk buyers ask for, because it works as the last step of a facial and fills neatly into 25 g, 30 g and 50 g jars. For a lighter cream without kojic acid, choose the avocado and aloe vera Avocado Glow Cream instead.

Avocado cream for facials and massage in salons

Salons and parlours use avocado cream in kg as the moisturising finish after cleansing, scrubbing and a face pack, and for a short face and neck massage. A rich avocado cream glides well under the fingers and leaves skin feeling soft and smooth. Take what you need out of the tub with a clean spatula, keep the tub closed between clients, and use a fresh bowl for each client.

Who buys avocado cream in bulk?

  • Salons and beauty parlours: use it as the moisturising step after a facial, at a much lower cost per gram than retail jars.
  • Resellers and online sellers: buy 1 kg, 5 kg or more and fill your own jar sizes.
  • New skincare brands: start with a small bulk quantity before committing to thousands of finished units.
  • Spas and bridal studios: keep one tub in the treatment room for massages and pre-make-up prep.

Avocado cream price per kg

The wholesale price of avocado cream per kg depends on three things:

  1. The cream: formulas with more active ingredients, such as kojic acid and vitamin B3, cost more per kg than the simple avocado and aloe vera cream.
  2. The quantity: the more kilos you order, the lower the rate per kg.
  3. The packing: loose cream in bulk tubs costs less than cream filled into finished jars.

That is why we quote each order separately. Send your requirement on WhatsApp and you will get a clear price per kg to compare.

What to check when you buy cream in bulk

  • A batch number and manufacturing date on every container.
  • The full ingredient list, so your own labels are accurate.
  • The use-before date, and how long the cream keeps once opened.
  • A sample first, to check texture and fragrance.
  • Sealed, clean containers on delivery.

How to store bulk avocado cream

Keep the tub tightly closed in a cool, dry place away from sunlight. Always use a clean, dry spatula, never fingers, and never put unused cream back in the tub. Open one tub at a time and finish older stock first.

If you plan to repack or sell the cream under your own brand, the labelling and licence rules for cosmetics in India apply to you. Check them before you sell.
